title: 第9章 砍我十年你在下面受供奉第10章 我还小请不要吃我
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
咚咚咚——
林恩又礼貌地连续敲了几次门。
但是却没有得到任何的回应，甚至连里面的脚步声都听不到一点。
林恩疑惑地挠了挠天灵盖。
“难道没人？”
与此同时，窗棂内，一个蜷缩着的小小的身影颤巍巍地伸出小手，从窗帘的盒子下面摸出了一把小小的左轮手枪，小手哆嗦地从怀里摸出了银制的子弹。
慢慢地，尽可能小心翼翼地将子弹扣进去，尽量不让自己发出任何的声响。
咔哒——一枚。
咔哒——两枚。
咔哒——三枚。
慢慢地扣到第六枚的时候，第七枚子弹却怎么也哆嗦地扣不进去。
“怎么进不去呢……”
“因为只能上六枚啊，没看到上面已经没有孔了吗？还往里面扣！”
那个躲在窗棂下的身影（；≧д≦）道：
“我也是第一次用枪呀，我哪知道有几枚呀！而且黑灯瞎火的！怎么可能看到……”
“……”
周围短暂地寂静。
阴风呼呼地吹来。
那个身影的表情咯噔一下变得空洞了起来。
等一下！

因为她可以百分之百地确定这个房子里面绝对绝对只有她自己一个人！
那刚才的那个声音是……
她下意识地慢慢地抬起了头。
只见就在那窗棂的表面之上，一张嘴角咧的老高的恐怖的脸，就这么贴在窗棂上，双眼圆噔噔地看着她，显然已经是看了她很长的一段时间了。
“你好！”
“鬼呀（ΩДΩ）！！！”
【叮！花耶受到了你强烈的惊吓，san值-20】
【叮！花耶受到了你强烈的惊吓，san值-30】
“喂！你听我解释！”
砰——
一声枪响。
那个小女孩顿时摸爬滚打地四处奔逃，几乎是以最快的速度冲出了卧室，拉开衣柜下面大大的抽屉，把自己塞了进去。
她用力地蜷缩在那里，（；д；）地双手紧抱着膝盖，长长的卷发把自己整个身体都遮住了。
不要被发现！
千万不要发现呀！
刚才虽然没有看清楚那到底是什么鬼，但毫无疑问绝对是某种吃小孩的可怕的恶灵！
她捂着嘴，大眼睛委屈地啪嗒啪嗒地往外冒着泪珠。
“呜呜——”
所以她怎么会这么惨。
content_en:
Dong dong dong——
Linn knocked on the door politely several times.
But he didn't get any response, and he couldn't even hear the footsteps inside.
Lin En scratched the Tianling Gai in confusion.
"Is there no one?"
At the same time, inside the window lattice, a crouched little figure stretched out his little hand tremblingly, took out a small revolver from under the curtain box, and took out the silver bullet from his arms with trembling hands.
Slowly and carefully insert the bullet into it, trying not to make any noise.
Click - one.
Click—two.
Click—three.
When the sixth bullet was slowly inserted, the seventh bullet could not be inserted without trembling.
"Why can't you get in..."
"Because you can only put six pieces on it. Didn't you see that there are no holes on it? You still have to push it in!"
The figure hiding under the window lattice (；≧д≦) said:
"This is also my first time using a gun. I didn't know how many there were! And it was all done in vain! How could I see..."
"..."
There was brief silence.
The dark wind blew loudly.
The figure's expression suddenly became hollow.
Wait a moment!
Because she can be 100% sure that she is absolutely the only one in this house!
That voice just now was...
She subconsciously raised her head slowly.
Just above the surface of the window lattice, I saw a terrifying face of Lao Gao with a grin at the corner of his mouth, just sticking to the window lattice, looking at her with round eyes, obviously he had been looking at her for a long time.
"Hello!"
"Ghost (ΩДΩ)!!!"
[Ding! Huaye was greatly frightened by you, her sanity value was -20]
[Ding! Huaye was greatly frightened by you, her sanity value was -30]
"Hey! Listen to my explanation!"
Bang——
There was a gunshot.
The little girl immediately ran around and rushed out of the bedroom as fast as she could. She opened the big drawer under the wardrobe and stuffed herself in it.
She curled up there hard, hugging her knees with her hands, and her long curly hair covered her entire body.
Don't get caught!
Don't find out!
Although I didn't see clearly what it was just now, there is no doubt that it is some kind of terrible evil spirit that eats children!
She covered her mouth, tears popping out of her big eyes in grievance.
"Woo-"
So how could she be so miserable?
